# THE WHITE REPORT — EPISODE 18 REEL SCRIPT (test fixture)
## SCRIPT (verbatim — segment texts copied verbatim from ep18/script.md)

[S1] A third of all Zcash sits in the dark — shielded, by choice. In September we called it Wall Street's private Bitcoin. The holding held; the rally didn't. Send this to the friend who sold the privacy trade.
[S2] ZCSH kept the bid: seven hundred seventy-two million in assets — two hundred eight million net inflows. Then the tape turned: eleven million out on the fifth, one point eight back on the sixth.
[S3] Underneath, the network shipped its biggest upgrade in years. NU7 cut block times from seventy-five seconds to twenty-five — and retired the first shielded pool, stranding twelve thousand ZEC.
[S4] Price tells the other half: eleven ninety-four — twenty-eight percent under the September high.
[S5] Risks, on the record: a counterfeiting flaw in the main pool, disclosed in June — patched, no evidence of use. Europe's MiCA bar lands July twenty twenty-seven.
